text: Functional smoothness is encoded in the certified row/column normalization geometries Q_alpha and R_beta; only degree-one nonsmooth penalties enter the Allen GPMF normalization theorem. Additive objective-quadratic smoothing under fixed metrics remains a distinct estimand. Greedy deflation is extraction-ordered with no orthogonality claim; simultaneous rank-k uses generalized-Stiefel constraints. Its empty-nonsmooth special case is solved by generalized cross-SVD with an exact-global theorem witness, while nonsmooth joint rank-k fails closed pending PALM.
